sql.project.getAllForCompanyProcess: select p.id, cp.company_id, cp.process_id, p.customer_id, p.project_name from flow.company_process cp inner join flow.project p on cp.id = p.company_process_id where cp.company_id = :companyId and cp.process_id = :processId;
sql.project.search: select p.id, p.project_name, p.customer_id, p.date_created, cp.status_type_id, st.status_type, pr.process_name from flow.project p inner join flow.company_process cp on cp.id = p.company_process_id inner join flow.process pr on pr.id = cp.process_id inner join flow.status_type st on st.id = cp.status_type_id where cp.company_id = :companyId and p.project_name ilike '%' || :query || '%' order by p.date_created desc limit :limit offset :offset
sql.project.searchCount: select count(*) from flow.project p inner join flow.company_process cp on cp.id = p.company_process_id inner join flow.customer c on c.id = p.customer_id where cp.company_id = :companyId and p.project_name ilike '%' || :query || '%'
sql.project.get: select p.id, cp.company_id, cp.process_id, p.customer_id, p.project_name, p.company_project_status_type_id, cpst.project_status_type, ( select row_to_json(o) from ( select u.id as "userId", u.first_name as "firstName", u.last_name as "lastName", u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS "fullName", po.position from blueraven.user u inner join flow.user_position up on up.user_id = u.id inner join flow.position po on po.id = up.position_id where up.id = p.user_position_id ) o ) AS owner from flow.company_process cp inner join flow.project p on cp.id = p.company_process_id inner join flow.company_project_status_type cpst on cpst.id = p.company_project_status_type_id where p.id = :projectId
sql.project.insert: insert into flow.project (customer_id, company_process_id, project_name, created_by_id, company_project_status_type_id) values (:customerId, :processId, :projectName, :createdById, :companyProjectStatusTypeId)
sql.project.getAllForCustomer: select p.id, cp.company_id, cp.process_id, p.customer_id, p.project_name, p.company_project_status_type_id, cpst.project_status_type from flow.company_process cp inner join flow.project p on cp.id = p.company_process_id and p.id = :projectId inner join flow.company_project_status_type cpst on cpst.id = p.company_project_status_type_id where p.customer_id = :customerId;
sql.project.getProcessStepsByProjectId: select ps.id as process_step_id, pps.id as project_process_step_id, pps.process_step_complete_date, pps.project_id, ps.process_step_name, coalesce(pps.date_modified, pps.date_created) as last_updated, cpsst.process_step_status_type, cpsst.process_step_status_type_id, ( select row_to_json(o) from ( select u.id as "userId", u.first_name as "firstName", u.last_name as "lastName", u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS "fullName", p.position from blueraven.user u inner join flow.user_position up on up.user_id = u.id inner join flow.position p on p.id = up.position_id where up.id = pps.user_position_id ) o ) AS owner from flow.project p inner join flow.project_process_step pps on pps.project_id = p.id inner join flow.process_step ps on ps.id = pps.process_step_id inner join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on cpsst.id = pps.company_process_step_status_type_id left join flow.user_position up on up.id = pps.user_position_id left join flow.user u on u.id = up.user_id where p.id = :projectId order by last_updated;
sql.project.getAttachments: select a.id, a.size, a.date_created, a.date_modified, a.filename, a.attachment_type_id, a.content_type, a.s3_key from flow.project_attachment pa inner join flow.attachment a on a.id = pa.attachment_id where pa.project_id = :projectId;
sql.project.addAttachment: insert into flow.project_attachment(attachment_id, project_id, created_by_id) values (:attachmentId, :projectId, :createdById)
sql.project.updateOwner: update flow.project set user_position_id = :userPositionId, modified_by_id = :userId, date_modified = now() where id = :projectId
sql.project.getActiveProjectStatusTypeByComp: select id, project_status_type_id, project_status_type, archived, date_created, date_modified, created_by_id, modified_by_id, company_id from flow.company_project_status_type cpst where company_id = :companyId and project_status_type_id = 1
sql.project.getOwners: select u.id as user_id, u.first_name, u.last_name, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name as full_name, up.id as user_position_id, p.position from flow.owner_position_id op inner join flow.user_position up on array[up.position_id] <@ op.position_ids inner join flow."user" u on u.id = up.user_id inner join flow.position p on p.id = up.position_id inner join flow.company_user_status_type cust on cust.company_id = p.company_id inner join flow.user_status_type ust on ust.company_user_status_type_id = cust.id and ust.user_id = u.id where op.owner_type_id = 2 and op.company_id = :companyId and cust.has_access is true and up.start_date <= now() and (up.end_date is null or up.end_date >= now()) order by u.last_name, u.first_name
